support_claim: Legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party, and the packet instructs treating the registry link as unresolved.
justification: Under the relation contract, SAME_ENTITY requires establishing evidence of identity and DISTINCT requires establishing evidence of distinctness; name alignment between billing and registry row 3840192 is compatibility only. The packet preserves multiple live registry candidates (including a Wyoming LLC) and explicitly states the registry link cannot be established, so neither disposition burden is met.
